prompts.prompt: Are we answering customers in public?
prompts.answer: On the Play Store the bank replied to 99.5% of 5,734 reviews in the window, with a median reply time of 8 minutes. But 99.7% of replies to negative reviews only redirect the customer to email, phone or chat rather than answering. 30 reviews still have no reply after 48 hours. X and App Store replies are not in this data.
